We revisit logistic regression trained with mini-batch SGD on a synthetic screening dataset and show that it reaches 0.494 test accuracy.

## Experimental setup

The model is logistic regression trained by mini-batch SGD for 15 epochs (batch size 32, a constant learning rate of 0.05, no weight decay and no class weighting). Predictions use a decision threshold of 0.5. Numbers are medians over 7 runs with different shuffling seeds.
